# Get-ZbxApiVersion

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the version of the Zabbix API a server runs.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxApiVersion [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxApiVersion cmdlet calls apiinfo.version on the current connection, or on -Connection, and writes the version as a System.Version, so a script can compare it with another version. apiinfo.version needs no login, but the command still needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer. Get-ZbxApiInfo writes the version together with the connection's name, endpoint and credential.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Get the API version

```powershell
Get-ZbxApiVersion
```

The result is a [version]: Major, Minor and Build are numbers.

### Example 2: Branch on the server's version

```powershell
if ((Get-ZbxApiVersion) -ge [version]'7.4') { 'Zabbix 7.4 or later' } else { 'Zabbix 7.0' }
```

A [version] compares as a version, so 7.4 is newer than 7.0 and 7.10 newer than 7.4.

## PARAMETERS

### -Connection

The server to talk to: a connection name from Get-ZbxContext, or the connection object. The current server when omitted.
